messages:
olga: draft RN snippet uploaded. keeping internal announce tiny: 2 bullets + one CTA. can someone sanity-check?
diego: quick look. what exact rollback gates do we want ops to use? numbers help.
nora: propose: rollback if p99 >30% vs baseline OR request_error_rate >2% sustained for 4m. also include CPU >78% sustained for 4m.
ops-oncall: those are actionable. add 'sustained for 4m' to the copy and include the pinned artifact name.
olga: will pin. artifact: `model/redwood-serve:2026-03-22-quantc-v1`. fallback: `model/redwood-serve:2026-02-01-fast`
diego: nice. compact internal snippet i suggest: "Internal: rolling canary for batching tweaks to improve short-session tail latency (~10-15% p99 reduction). Monitor canary for 25m. Rollback triggers: p99 >30% vs baseline OR errors >2% for 4m OR CPU >78% for 4m. Model pinned to model/redwood-serve:2026-03-22-quantc-v1 (fallback: 2026-02-01-fast). Ops oncall: @ops-oncall. Links: PR https://git.internal/rn/4401, smoke https://ci.internal/6622"
ops-oncall: please add deploybot tag so the bot links back: `deploybot:tag=rn_batch_0322,quiet_window=00:25`. that quiet window helps avoid noisy pings.
olga: can someone start a small canary with that tag? want to validate deploybot summary includes pinned tag.
diego: starting canary now. note: west1 warmup may spike; ignore blips <2m.

deploy-bot: Canary start accepted.

```
canary id: cb-20260322-15
model: model/redwood-serve:2026-03-22-quantc-v1
variant: canary (4%)
start_ts: 1787654360
```
ops-oncall: watching. i'll post +12m and +25m health updates.
nora: docs note: add one sentence for product "no user-facing changes expected". keeps PM calm.
olga: added product sentence. will publish public microcopy after +25m if green.

deploy-bot: Canary health (12m):
```
cb-20260322-15: p50 46ms (+0%), p95 185ms (-8%), p99 330ms (-11%)
errors: 0.5%
CPU: 64%
status: healthy
```
ops-oncall: 12m looks fine. continuing to monitor.
diego: prepping public RN snippet in docs repo so it's ready to push.
nora: docs OK to publish once we get +25m green. :thumbsup: 
ops-oncall: 25m summary: metrics steady, thresholds not hit. proceeding with rollout per plan.
olga: rolling out broader fleet now. i'll post final public blurb and close thread. thanks all!
